dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Primary progressive multiple sclerosis (spastic paraparesis phenotype) – an inflammatory demyelinating disorder of the central nervous system suggested by the chronic progressive lower-limb spastic weakness with secondary disuse atrophy, normal peripheral nerve and muscle studies, normal spinal cord imaging, and CSF-restricted oligoclonal bands.

1. Hereditary spastic paraplegia (HSP gene panel was not performed; would require next-generation sequencing of SPAST, ATL1, REEP1, etc.)
2. HTLV-1–associated myelopathy/tropical spastic paraparesis (requires HTLV-1 serology)
3. Adrenomyeloneuropathy (requires very-long-chain fatty acid assay and ABCD1 gene testing)
